implementation: Process-local complete-byte verifier, shared only inside one checkpoint. Reuse requires unchanged device/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns after a complete read in that same invocation; no persisted digest cache. Remote pinned-commit byte verification remains independent.

actual_byte_reads.scope: Process-local only. Every reused digest came from complete bytes read in this checkpoint and unchanged device/inode/size/mtime/ctime. No persisted checksum cache or remote-byte proof.

scope: Two actual checkpoints with different inventory/state and cache conditions, not a controlled speed experiment or proof of restored generation throughput. Both performed original sync, art audit, HIGH priority regeneration, four-sample build verification, ordinary push and immutable-commit original PNG readback. No full game export or actual game display acceptance.
